question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ced485d37f2f4998348aed5b888bcb408bb830fe04e31735738fd4817f906c13.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: The Symbol 'Arrow' has shifted alternatively. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/722b76381d5a4fca3657fddce7b8cc427be3102c7b7852c7c52a13a8d85ce449.png] 

Step II: The Symbol 'Triangle' are getting rotated in 90 degree in anti-clockwise direction, and shaded alternatively [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e906e5d4884cc85c1532333ae6f19c2683c99244837bbb7b62d434c43690e84a.png] 

Step III: The Symbol 'Arrow' has shifted one place in clockwise direction. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/275d7d5b8887e2ca7a5b9cdf6611ccc4daaa5ffac9c236ce1f5640cea415f815.png] 

So, the complete series will be: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/565b3bce6c35cfad8866ce8a0a4787a1d0acaf5700d9e47770c366a3e5a86fb3.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
